source: "96% of Teams will Lose when Down by 21, at Q3 9:27, and with the Ball"; "98% of Teams will Lose when Down by 9, at Q4 3:45 without the Ball"; "~100% of Teams will Lose when Down by 5, 9 seconds to go, and the ball"; "~100% of Teams will Lose when Down by 14 at Q4 5:03"
claim: The eventual winners' lowest win probabilities were 0.0423 in game 1 (home side, down 21 in Q3 with 9:27 left), 0.0208 in game 4 (away side, down 9 in Q4 with 3:45 left), 0.0014 in game 5 (away side, down 5 in Q4 with 0:09 left) and 0.0042 in game 7 (home side, down 14 in Q4 with 5:04 left), i.e. 95.77%, 97.92%, 99.86% and 99.58% chances of losing.

source: But by the end of the 3rd, the game was tied. Miami went on a 10 minute, 29-8 run.
